verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS voice platform like telli, so the axis applies. The evidence contains no documented way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. Data retention (telli-docs-25) and consent-conditional call recording (telli-docs-26) are adjacent data-handling controls and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
